decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that builds directly on the firm’s core spraying business and is still shown in 2024, management is likely to justify its investment and treat any weak uptake as temporary rather than withdraw it quickly.

Because the low-pressure injection pump has its own page in both years, is close to the established offer, and reflects visible development effort from test phase to market, management would be strongly inclined to continue with it.
The product extends the existing pump range using proven in-house air-motor technology, so its strategic fit is high and management can readily defend staying the course.
Fire protection flow monitoring has a dedicated page in both years and supports the firm’s announced move toward future-oriented and more interoperable solutions, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although only launched in 2024 and less prominently presented, it is close to the firm’s established two-component spraying business and the recency of the investment makes management likely to give it more time.
